name: waitfeed-dev
description: Dev harness for the WaitFeed monorepo — typecheck and tests. The published npm package lives in packages/waitfeed.

scripts.build:agy: esbuild packages/waitfeed/agy/src/scheduler.ts packages/waitfeed/agy/src/statusline.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outdir=packages/waitfeed/agy/dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=warning
scripts.build:claude: esbuild packages/waitfeed/claude/src/scheduler.ts packages/waitfeed/claude/src/statusline.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outdir=packages/waitfeed/claude/dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=warning
scripts.pretest: npm run -s build:agy && npm run -s build:claude
